Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the informationgiven in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the

statements.

All bikes are roads.

Some roads are TVs.

(II) All roads are TVs.

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

405 ÷ 2 + 369 × 9 − 32 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged.
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

405 ÷ 2 + 369 × 9 − 32 = ?

Replace the operators with their corresponding new meanings:

405 × 2 − 369 ÷ 9 + 32 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= **405 × 2**__ − __**369 ÷ 9**__ + 32

= __**810 − 41**__ + 32

= __**769 + 32**__

= 801

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: Rohan starts from point A and drives 8 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 12 km, turns left and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.solution:

Rohan starts from point A and drives 8 km towards the north.

He then takes a left turn, drives 12 km, turns left and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at point P.

⇒ 6 × 2 = 12 

⇒ 12 + 3 = 15 

⇒ 15 × 2 = 30 

Here, the logic followed.

For, 4 - 8 - 11 - 22

⇒ 4 × 2 = 8 

⇒ 8 + 3 = 11 

⇒ 11 × 2 = 22
